results.q: Can Circles help build local economic growth?
results.a:
Yes, Circles can help strengthen the local economy because Circles encourages the exchange of locally available goods/services for the fulfillment of daily needs.




Circles users can send or receive Circles Points in exchange for goods/services. Once users setup their business within the Circles App, they can also offer their goods/services through the Circles Market for other users to find.




The daily points provided by the Circles app to each users offers additional resource to enhance the exchange of goods/services within their community. In other words, Circles users can use their cash to meet other needs that cannot be obtained by using Circles Points and allocate their cash for savings and or investments. Therefore, their economic capacity, selling power and purchasing power also increases.

results.q: Can Circles help increase people's income? How?
results.a: People can use Circles to exchange goods/services with other users that accept Circles Points. The Circles Points that will be given to every users, everyday, may increase their ability to fulfill their needs, daily.
